en.askTitle: Swap in your own pay, bills and freelance income and get a budget workbook that copes with irregular months
en.runTitle: A US household with a salary and a freelance income: a budget workbook that survives uneven months

fields.label: Twelve months of freelance income and business costs
fields.value: Partner is a freelance designer whose income swings a lot from month to month

fields.label: Independently estimated tax-reserve rate
fields.placeholder: e.g. 25% of each freelance payment set aside for tax

fields.label: Reconciled checking, after-tax buffer and each fund
fields.placeholder: e.g. checking $4,200, tax buffer $3,000, car-insurance fund $600

fields.label: Real bills, spending, loan balances/APRs/minimums and next renewal amounts/dates
fields.value: Rent, two car payments, student loans and daycare; annual bills for car insurance, Amazon Prime, holiday gifts and the dentist

en.template: Adapt this budget for {place}, using {pay}, twelve months of {freelance}, {taxrate}, reconciled {balances}, and {bills}. Work in a copy and preserve formulas. Explain blanks versus zeros, catch-up savings, closed-month transfer/target snapshots and rent-day cash; flag biweekly/daily gaps. Check twelve months of cash conservation, warnings and payoff caps. Do not invent prices, tax or income, connect accounts, move money, contact providers or publish.

phases.title: Pick the cost anchors and decide how uneven freelance income gets averaged
Build the example workbook and a one-page guide while a reviewer tests the model
phases.note: Income, bills, annual-bill savings, debt payoff and a 12-month dashboard
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer first called the workbook “not ready for dependable household use”. One example: entering 15 January as a car-insurance due date scheduled $0 for January instead of $1,200. It listed four faults in all, and each was fixed.

phases.title: Recalculate every formula, run scenario tests and check the charts
phases.judgment: The re-check confirmed all four faults were gone. The final workbook recalculated 1,181 formulas with no errors and passed 13 scenario checks. Public cost figures are labelled apart from made-up ones: the $2,100 rent could not be matched to an official rent table, so it is marked as fictional.

workers: Looked up current public figures for food, rent, daycare, car insurance and subscriptions, noting each date and what it covers
Independently reviewed the budget model, listed what was wrong, then re-checked it after the fixes

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的收入、账单和自由职业收入，拿到一份能应付收入起伏的预算表
zh.runTitle: 美国一户家庭，一份工资加一份自由职业收入：扛得住收入起伏的预算表

fields.label: 十二个月自由职业收款及业务费用
fields.value: 伴侣是自由职业设计师，收入月与月之间起伏很大

fields.label: 独立估算的税款预留比例
fields.placeholder: 例如：每笔自由职业收款留 25% 作税款

fields.label: 已分别对账的支票账户、税后缓冲金和各专项金
fields.placeholder: 例如：支票账户 4,200 美元、税款缓冲金 3,000 美元、车险专项金 600 美元

fields.label: 真实账单、消费、贷款余额年利率最低还款及下次续费金额日期
fields.value: 房租、两笔车贷、学生贷款和托儿费；每年一次的车险、亚马逊 Prime、节日礼物和牙医

zh.template: 请按{place}调整预算，用{pay}、十二个月{freelance}、{taxrate}、已分别对账的{balances}，以及{bills}。在副本保留公式，说明空白与零、到期补足、已结月份转账和目标快照、房租日现金，指出每两周发薪和每日时点缺口；查十二个月现金守恒、警告和还清上限。不编价格、税或收入，不连账号、转钱、联系或发布。

phases.title: 选定费用参照，并决定怎么平均起伏不定的自由职业收入
做出示例表格和一页说明，同时由复核同事测试模型
phases.note: 收入、账单、年度费用储备、还债和 12 个月总览
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事一开始给出的结论是“还不能放心用”。比如，把车险到期日填成 1 月 15 日，表格里 1 月竟然记 0 美元，而不是 1,200 美元。它一共列出四处问题，之后都改好了。

phases.title: 重算每个公式，做情景测试，检查图表
phases.judgment: 复核确认四处问题都已消失。最终表格重算了 1,181 个公式，没有报错，13 项情景测试全部通过。公开的费用数字和虚构的数字分开标注：2,100 美元的房租没能对上官方租金表，所以标为虚构。

workers: 查食品、房租、托儿、车险和订阅的最新公开数字，并注明各自的日期和适用范围
独立审查预算模型，列出问题，修改后再复查一遍
